snippet.title: Shadow Dancer On SEGA Mega Drive (Genesis) Part 1
snippet.description:
Playthrough part 1.

Shadow Dancer is the Mega Drive sequel to ''The Revenge Of Shinobi'' released in 1990 this game features all new different moves to master aswell as Musashi's faithful dog to help him. The music is excellent and so is the graphics, the only thing I find extremely annoying in this Shinobi game is that one hit kills you and you have to go back to the start of the stage. The dog cannot attack all the mercenaries either and unless you have the power up item which increases the power of your shurikens, you can't kill the coloured ninja's unless you're standing really close to them. Overall I think this is a much improved version over the 8-bit Master System version and this is my flawless victory through the game.

The story in this game goes- there is a new brand of evil threatening to take over New York known as ''Union Lizzard'' who are bent on world domination and destruction. They made the fatal mistake of murdering Musashi's good friend Kato in New York. Now Joe Musashi has adopted Kato's fathful hound and has set out on revenge in the big apple, he will not rest until every last evil henchmen is defeated. This is the secret of Shinobi.

This has been recorded off my moddified model 2 console. Enjoy!!
